about: Shows and hides the block beneath a control.
arrives: Arrives Thursday between nine and noon. Somebody has to be in to sign for it.

motion.about: How the block opens: sliding, fading, or at once. Press the control to see it.
motion.title: Motion

preview.about: A block that leaves a strip showing while closed, so a reader sees the first line and the control reveals the rest.
preview.title: Preview

size.about: Every step the block is read at, each drawn closed so the scale reads as one column of controls. The step sets the control, the block and the mark together.
size.title: Sizes

terms: Deliveries run Monday to Friday and arrive between eight in the morning and six in the evening. A parcel nobody is in for goes to the depot named on the card, where it is held for ten days. A parcel a courier could not fit through the door is brought back the next working day at no charge. Where a delivery is late by more than a working day the postage is returned, and where it is late by three the order is.

status.about: Every status, on the subtle look. A block a page folds away is often a block about something, so the status points the palette and the look reads it: one word turns the fill, the edge and what a press does. The plain look draws no fill and no edge, so a palette set on it turns nothing.
status.title: Statuses

title: Collapsible

variant.about: Every look, each open so the block shows. The raised look carries an elevation as well as a line, which is what tells it from the outlined one on a page already the panel's colour.
variant.title: Looks
